items.difficulty_reason: The author extends relative Plucker identities to skew Schur functions by detailed hook-pair determinant calculations and a nine-class decomposition with parity-dependent exceptional terms. All supporting propositions and their proofs are retained, so the substantive skewing and cancellation work remains part of this item rather than a presumed background result.
